earnings.title: 1049 Camino Dos Rios
highlights: Third quarter net sales of $1,684.9 million, an increase of 9.4% compared with last year
Third quarter GAAP diluted earnings per share of $5.82, an increase of 25.2% compared with last year
Third quarter non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $6.72, an increase of 20.6% compared with last year
Teledyne today reported third quarter 2026 net sales of $1,684.9 million compared with net sales of $1,539.5 million for the third quarter of 2025, an increase of 9.4%.
Third quarter cash from operations of $352.5 million and free cash flow of $319.5 million

quotes.text: Our third quarter sales and operating earnings were the strongest in Teledyne’s history.

outlook: Raising full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share outlook to $21.71 to $21.87 compared with the prior outlook of $20.73 to $20.99, and raising full year 2026 non-GAAP earnings per share outlook to $25.40 to $25.50, compared with the prior outlook of $24.45 to $24.65

Based on its current outlook, the company’s management believes that fourth quarter 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $5.68 to $5.83, and full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $21.71 to $21.87.

The company’s management further believes that fourth quarter 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $6.60 to $6.70, and full year 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $25.40 to $25.50.

items.heading: A possible recession in the United States or globally may adversely affect us.
items.group: Risks Related to our Business and Industry

items.heading: Acquisitions and our ability to make acquisitions involve inherent risks that may adversely affect our operating results and financial condition.
items.group: Risks Related to our Business and Industry

items.heading: Increased prices for components and raw materials used in our products and higher labor and shipping costs could adversely impact our profitability.

We have experienced component and raw material shortages in the past that impacted our ability to manufacture and ship all the product for which we have demand, and these constraints may continue in the future.
We may not have sufficient resources to fund all future research and development and capital expenditures.

We may be unable to successfully introduce new and enhanced products in a timely and cost-effective manner or increase our participation in new markets, which could harm our profitability and prospects.
